text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens with good physical and mental health; 2. Capable of affording the necessary expenditure; 3. No criminal record; 4. Applicants who have one of the following circumstances must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years, and have resided abroad for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (before April 30 of the enrollment year) before submitting their application as an international student:（1）Born in Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan, and acquired foreign nationality.（2）Both parents (or one of them) are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, while the applicant himself/herself has foreign nationality from the time of birth. 5. Age Range of Applicants Scholarship application: 18 to 35 years old 6. Educational background: High school graduate or equivalent; 7. Language Level: English-taught programs: IELTS (academic) 5.5, TOEFL IBT 72 , or equivalent.
